jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Develop and oversee the data and solution architecture for a strategic platform modernization initiative.
• Analyze existing application and data structures to define future-state architectural goals.
• Design scalable, secure, and maintainable cloud-native solutions within the Azure ecosystem.
• Provide expert guidance to development teams and stakeholders regarding technical choices and architectural best practices.
• Manage and support the Azure DevOps environment to streamline technical delivery.
• Ensure seamless integration between legacy systems and modern architectural components.
• Support governance, security, and compliance requirements within the architecture domain.

Requirements

• You have 5+ years of experience in data architecture and complex enterprise data modeling.
• You bring 5+ years of experience with Azure DevOps administration and management.
• You possess 5+ years of experience writing SQL queries for data analysis.
• You have 3+ years of experience within the Belgian energy sector.
• You bring experience in designing microservices and cloud-native architecture.
• You possess the skills to translate conceptual information models into logical data models.
• You're experienced in defining and implementing a technical test strategy.
• You are fluent in English with C1 level proficiency in Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Python programming.
• Knowledge of UMIG 6 and UMIG DGO processes.

Responsibilities

• Develop and validate AI platform functionality using LLM harnesses and agent workflows.
• Translate business needs into user stories, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria.
• Onboard teams to new AI capabilities through workshops, demonstrations, and hands-on sessions.
• Measure and collect user feedback to drive continuous improvement of the platform.
• Assess internal and external AI capabilities to provide recommendations for future enhancements.
• Maintain clear documentation ensuring traceability from business requirements to technical implementation.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of experience in functional analysis, requirements engineering, and process modeling.
• You bring technical knowledge of LLM harnesses, agent workflows, RAG, and prompt engineering.
• You possess a solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure tools such as Azure, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
• You're skilled in designing test scenarios and automated evaluations for model behavior and tool integration.
• You have experience inspecting logs and agent execution traces to debug issues related to token usage, context, and latency.
• You're proactive and solution-oriented with a proven track record in stimulating user adoption and onboarding.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Development experience in Python and TypeScript.
• Knowledge of Figma and design thinking practices.
• Experience with Targetprocess or similar Agile project management platforms.
• Familiarity with digital user experience, web design, or marketing content design.

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

Senior SAP S/4HANA AP/AR & Business Partner Expert - Major Migration Programme - Brussels

Are you an experienced SAP S/4HANA specialist looking to play a key advisory role in a major transformation project?

We are partnering with a leading organisation in the Belgian financial services sector undertaking a strategic SAP ECC to S/4HANA Brownfield migration.

This is an opportunity to support the transformation of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Business Partner processes while working closely with internal business and master data teams.

As a trusted functional expert, you will help stakeholders understand SAP standard functionalities, evaluate available solutions and ensure a smooth transition towards S/4HANA.
Senior SAP S/4HANA AP/AR & Business Partner Expert - The Job
You will:

• Advise business teams on SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Business Partner and Customer Vendor Integration (CVI).
• Assess differences between ECC and S/4HANA, recommend standard solutions and evaluate impacts on master data and P2P/O2C processes.
• Support business stakeholders through functional guidance, knowledge transfer, testing activities and validation of implementation partner recommendations.
Senior SAP S/4HANA AP/AR & Business Partner Expert - Your Profile
You have:

• Strong functional expertise in SAP FI-AP, FI-AR, Business Partner and CVI, including customer and supplier master data.
• Proven experience with SAP S/4HANA, ideally involving ECC to S/4HANA migrations and integration with MM/SD processes.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex SAP functionalities to non-technical business stakeholders.
Fluent English is required; Dutch is a strong advantage.

jobs.occupation: Adoption Manager – Digital Transformation & Change Management
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Develop pragmatic adoption plans for digital initiatives including communication, enablement, and follow-up KPIs.
• Engage proactively with product and project teams to ensure solutions are ready for successful field implementation.
• Organize train-the-trainer sessions and develop practical material such as training packages and implementation guides.
• Facilitate recurrent adoption forums with network representatives to capture feedback and identify barriers.
• Track network implementation and maintain clear adoption metrics and reporting.
• Translate complex project information into simple, actionable material for field teams and internal stakeholders.

Requirements

• Experience in change management, digital transformation, or network enablement.
• You possess strong roll-out capabilities and the ability to drive adoption strategies operationally.
• You're comfortable facilitating workshops, training, and train-the-trainer sessions.
• You bring proficiency in Office 365 and SharePoint.
• You have experience working with adoption metrics and turning data into improvement actions.
• You possess a critical mindset combined with strong stakeholder management skills.
• You're proactive and able to translate complex product information into actionable field material.
• You are fluent in English with full professional proficiency in either Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with structured change methodologies such as ADKAR.
• Previous experience in automotive, retail, or franchise network environments.
• Experience with large-scale digital transformation programs involving User Journey mapping.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager – Digital Payments & PCI-DSS
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Lead the end-to-end delivery of the digital payment ecosystem modernization, including the procurement and implementation of new acquiring and PSP services.
• Drive the compliance and certification efforts for the payment ecosystem, ensuring full adherence to regulatory standards.
• Orchestrate cross-functional teams across finance, legal, security, and architecture to consolidate complex business and technical requirements.
• Define the target architecture for payment flows and manage technical transitions between legacy and future service providers.
• Monitor project risks, dependencies, budgets, and timelines while providing strategic reporting to senior management.
• Direct the preparation of public procurement documents, technical specifications, and tender evaluations for large-scale IT and payment services.

Requirements

• You have 8+ years of experience in complex project management within regulated environments.
• You bring 3+ years of specialized expertise in electronic payments, including PSP, Acquiring, and monetics.
• You possess a proven track record in PCI-DSS compliance projects or comparable payment security initiatives.
• You're experienced in public procurement, including drafting RFP specifications and managing tender processes.
• You have advanced skills in budget management and risk and dependency management.
• You possess strong Supplier Relationship Management skills, particularly with IT and payment service providers.
• You have experience working within Agile frameworks and coordinating multidisciplinary teams.
• You're proactive and solution-oriented with exceptional analytical and synthesis capabilities.
• You are native in Dutch or French with professional working proficiency in English.
Nice to Haves

• Certification in PRINCE2 Practitioner or Project Management Professional (PMP).
• Knowledge of Account Based Ticketing (ABT) or EMV payment systems.
• Experience in test management for payment solutions.

jobs.occupation: IT Project Manager – Application Integration & Data Management
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Analyze user requirements and collaborate with external partners to design effective technical solutions.
• Coordinate cross-application implementations and integrations while maintaining the integrity of the overarching data model.
• Lead multiple IT projects, serving as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and third-party IT vendors.
• Oversee validation activities and participate in active testing to ensure high-quality software delivery.
• Monitor application availability and security while implementing continuous improvements to the IT landscape.
• Manage implementation risks and challenge business requests to ensure alignment with technical governance.

Requirements

• You have experience in professional roles such as IT Functional Analyst, Project Manager, or Data Expert.
• You possess a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology or equivalent expertise.
• You bring experience with IT Governance processes, specifically focusing on Release Management and Change Management.
• You possess strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset with the ability to investigate data-level issues independently.
• You're a clear and proactive communicator, capable of managing relationships with both internal stakeholders and external suppliers.
• You are native in Dutch with a strong knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes or the Telecom industry.
• Technical familiarity with SQL, Scripting, or ETL processing.
• Experience working with GIS data.
• Curiosity regarding emerging IT evolutions and a drive for continuous optimization.

Responsibilities

• Take end-to-end ownership of product features from initial analysis and technical design through to implementation and deployment.
• Act as the technical point of reference and domain owner for specific product areas.
• Build and maintain software across the full stack with a heavy focus on backend engineering.
• Translate product and business requirements into scalable, maintainable, and practical technical solutions.
• Collaborate with Product Owners to make informed trade-offs between product value and technical sustainability.
• Contribute to engineering excellence in areas such as architecture, testing, CI/CD, and operational reliability.
• Share technical knowledge and mentor team members to raise the overall technical level.

Requirements

• 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with a solid backend foundation.
• You have experience designing, building, and operating software in production using Docker and Kubernetes.
• You possess a good understanding of modern SaaS concepts such as API design, distributed systems, authentication, and multi-tenancy.
• You bring experience with data technologies such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Elasticsearch.
• You have worked with modern delivery practices including CI/CD and automated deployments.
• You're comfortable investigating root causes and reasoning about architectural trade-offs.
• You possess a product mindset, focusing on solving core problems rather than just implementing features.
• You are fluent in Dutch with a good command of English.
Nice to Haves

• Hands-on experience with Golang as a primary backend language.
• Experience with Vue.js for frontend interface development.
• Knowledge of large-scale data processing using Kafka or Parquet.
• Experience with object storage platforms such as Ceph S3.
• Interest in using AI to strengthen engineering practices.

Our client is a leading international industrial group with operations across multiple continents and an ambitious growth strategy driven by innovation and strategic investments.To strengthen its specialist M&A Legal team, the organisation is looking to appoint a Senior Legal Counsel based in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior Legal Counsel - M&A, you will act as lead legal adviser on high-profile international transactions.Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading the legal execution of domestic and international acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures and strategic investments.
• Managing complex legal due diligence exercises and coordinating specialist legal input across multiple jurisdictions.
• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documentation, including share purchase agreements, joint venture agreements, transition service agreements, NDAs and other ancillary documents.
• Advising on transaction structuring and identifying pragmatic solutions to legal and commercial risks.
• Partnering with internal stakeholders across Corporate Strategy, M&A, Finance, Treasury, Tax, HR, IT and Compliance throughout the deal lifecycle.
• Managing signing, closing and post-closing processes.
• Supporting integrations, carve-outs and corporate reorganisations following completed transactions.
• Coordinating and managing external legal counsel internationally while maintaining ownership of transaction execution.
• Advising senior management on strategic legal considerations impacting investment decisions.
• Contributing to the continuous development of the company's M&A legal function and best practices.

• Belgian Master's degree in Law.
• Approximately 8  years of post-qualification experience in Corporate/M&A law.
• Experience gained within a leading international law firm and/or a sophisticated international in-house legal environment.
• Demonstrated experience leading complex domestic and cross-border M&A transactions.
• Excellent drafting, negotiation and project management skills.
• Strong commercial judgement and ability to translate legal complexity into practical business advice.
• Confident communicator with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
• Fluent in English. French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.

For our client in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to develop business across the Middle East and Africa.Our client is an international wholesaler of industrial sealing solutions, supplying technical distributors and industrial trading partners. Its product range includes O-rings, industrial seals and customised sealing products for a wide variety of applications.The company is looking for a commercially driven professional who enjoys approaching potential customers, developing new accounts and turning opportunities into actual sales.This position has a strong business development focus. You will work closely with the External Sales Representative to expand the customer portfolio across the MEA region while continuing to develop relationships with existing clients.What will you do? 
• Actively identify and approach potential B2B customers across the Middle East and Africa. 
• Prospect for new business opportunities and open new customer accounts. 
• Follow up on commercial leads and convert opportunities into sales. 
• Build relationships with new customers and develop long-term business opportunities. 
• Maintain and expand existing customer accounts. 
• Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling. 
• Prepare quotations and follow up on commercial proposals. 
• Process orders and respond to customer enquiries. 
• Maintain regular contact with customers by telephone and email. 
• Understand customer requirements and propose suitable sealing solutions. 
• Work closely with the External Sales Representative on commercial activities and customer development. 
• Monitor sales opportunities and report on commercial progress. 
• Provide professional customer service and ensure timely follow-up of requests.
 
• You have a commercial and/or technical background. 
• You have experience in B2B sales and/or customer service. 
• You genuinely enjoy prospecting and approaching new customers. 
• You are confident initiating commercial conversations and following up on opportunities. 
• You are fluent in English and French, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage, but not a requirement. 
• Experience with customers in the Middle East or Africa is a plus. 
• Experience selling technical or industrial products is an additional asset. 
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general business software. 
• You communicate clearly and know how to build professional relationships. 
• You take initiative and are motivated by commercial results. 
• You can work independently while maintaining close contact with your sales colleagues. 
• You are customer-oriented, persistent and organised in your approach.

For our client in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to support and develop customer relationships across Eastern Europe.Our client is an international wholesaler specialising in industrial sealing solutions, including O-rings, technical seals and customised sealing products. The company supplies technical distributors and industrial trading partners worldwide.You will join a small, internationally oriented sales team where customer relationships, technical understanding and commercial initiative are equally important.Your focus will be on managing existing accounts while identifying opportunities to develop new business. Approximately 70% of your activities will involve existing customers, with the remaining 30% focused on new customer acquisition.What will you do? 
• Manage and develop relationships with existing B2B customers. 
• Identify potential customers and open new accounts. 
• Work closely with the External Sales Representative to develop sales opportunities. 
• Prepare quotations, calculate prices and follow up on commercial proposals. 
• Process customer orders and monitor their progress. 
• Maintain regular contact with customers by telephone and email. 
• Identify cross-selling opportunities within the existing product range. 
• Encourage customers to use the company's digital ordering tools. 
• Handle customer enquiries, complaints and commercial requests. 
• Keep customer information accurate and up to date in the internal system. 
• Develop an understanding of customer applications, market developments and competitors. 
• Monitor commercial opportunities and report on sales activities. 
• Support colleagues when needed and contribute to the daily operation of the sales department.
 
• You have a commercial and/or technical background. 
• You have at least 4 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably involving technical products. 
• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Polish, Czech or another Eastern European language is a strong advantage. 
• Knowledge of French and/or Arabic is an additional asset. 
• You are comfortable working with Excel and other business software. 
• You enjoy maintaining customer relationships and identifying commercial opportunities. 
• You communicate clearly and confidently with international customers. 
• You are organised and capable of managing several customer requests simultaneously. 
• You take initiative and follow up on commercial opportunities without needing constant supervision. 
• You work well in a small team and remain focused when priorities change. 
• An interest in industrial products and technical applications will help you succeed in this role.

Our client is a leading international insurance company with a strong presence in the Belgian market. Through innovation, customer-centricity, and operational excellence, the organization continuously invests in transforming and growing their Business Units.To support the successful execution of its strategic ambitions, our client is currently looking for a Strategic Change Analyst to join its Brussels-based office.

Jobomschrijving

• Support the definition, structuring and monitoring of the Business Unit strategic roadmap
• Translate strategic priorities into compelling communication materials, executive presentations and impactful storytelling
• Prepare presentations, reports and strategic updates for senior management and executive committees
• Conduct business and strategic analyses to support decision-making and identify growth opportunities
• Perform ad hoc studies related to profitability, operational efficiency, organizational effectiveness and innovation
• Develop recommendations and action plans based on data-driven insights
• Contribute to the optimization and simplification of internal processes across the business unit
• Coordinate and monitor strategic initiatives, transformation projects and change management activities
• Support the annual budgeting process and oversee the monitoring of business unit operating expenses
• Prepare financial analyses, budget forecasts and management reporting
• Collaborate closely with Finance teams on cost allocation, financial planning and performance monitoring
• Act as a key liaison between business stakeholders and Finance to ensure alignment on financial objectives and priorities
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives within budgeting, reporting and governance processes

• Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Insurance or a related field
• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in strategy, consulting, business analysis, project management, transformation or change management
• Strong understanding of the Life Insurance sector, including products, regulations and market dynamics
• Experience supporting strategic planning, business transformation and roadmap execution
• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations
• Strong financial acumen with experience in budgeting, financial analysis and management reporting
• Proven ability to create impactful presentations and deliver effective executive-level storytelling
• Experience in process improvement and cross-functional project coordination
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across multiple business functions
• Highly organized, autonomous and capable of challenging assumptions in a constructive manner
• Ability to synthesize complex information and present clear conclusions to management
• Fluency in French/Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
